content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, Thank you for sending over the contract. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to request a few small adjustments to the agreement before signing. - Regarding the clause "Invoices are payable Net 90.", waiting three months for payment creates a cash flow strain, so I propose changing this to: "Invoices are payable Net 30.". - Regarding the clause "Payment period: Net 90", this also creates a significant cash flow burden, so I propose modifying it to: "Payment period: Net 30". Please let me know if these adjustments work for you. Best regards,
